description: Creates a draft request from petal_id, region, fields, description, the customer's email and urgency. Invalid or missing values are rejected with isError, naming the allowed options; nothing is saved. On success Bidit emails the customer a confirmation link, and businesses are invited only after the customer confirms. The result has request_id, access_key (a credential for this request, not shown to users), detail_score and suggested_details (optional details that affect pricing). The email demo@justbidit.ai creates a demo request: demo=true, no email is sent and no business is contacted.

description.description: Short description of the job in the customer's words.

email.description: Customer's email, used only to send the confirm link.
